summary: CI&T Inc filed a 6-K announcing its Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for May 26, 2026, and the appointment of Marcelo Dodsworth Penna as a director to succeed Patrice Philippe Nogueira Baptista Etlin, who resigned on April 2, 2026. The filing details the AGM agenda, record date of April 24, 2026, and the new director's background at Advent International. This is a forced board departure and replacement, constituting a management change event. No financial terms, prices, or deal mechanics are involved; the event is purely a governance update with a routine AGM component.
